headline: India Faces High LNG Costs Driven by Declining Domestic Gas Output
summary: India's natural gas imports are heading for a record in October despite global LNG prices tripling in a year. Falling domestic production forces the country to purchase higher-priced imports to supply expanding gas networks.
why: India is one of the world's fastest-growing energy importers. Increased spot market LNG purchases weigh on import bills and domestic power costs.
